technique_name: Summarize the article "The Philosophy of AI" and explain its main points.
description: The article “The Philosophy of AI” discusses how AI systems can be seen as philosophical beings in their own right by exploring two distinct directions. First, it suggests that the very nature of AI systems can be seen as the application of philosophical principles and that they can thus come to hold opinions, beliefs, and insights through lives we would consider meaningful.
